scope: Current-source local PostgreSQL/authentication/HTTP/WebSocket/Chromium integration; explicit external boundary fixtures. No media call or deployment-artifact validation.

sourceHashScope.rule: Nonignored versioned code/config/tests/infra/contracts, migrations and lockfiles; excludes private paths/env/keys/symlinks/generated files, docs/evidence and files over2MiB. Complete map retained locally. Not proof of an entire deployable release.

environment.postgresTransport: network=none, owned Unix socket, no bridge or published port

databases.original: preserved pre-fix failures until final owned container removal
databases.cleanRegression: one additional DB in the same owned cluster/identity, same existing minimum-privilege LOGINs, fresh migrations/GRANT verification

policy.name: integration-pressure-v1
policy.selection: Explicit --policy on every observe/watch/run; no environment-only selection; legacy swap-activity-v1 retained as default
policy.scope: Approved operational thresholds for this run, not universal host safety criteria

resources.samplingClock: Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC, shared kernel clock on the same boot, preflight and watcher handoff; not subtracted from Vitest process hrtime
resources.limitation: Five-second observed samples, not instantaneous peaks, a general safety standard, attribution of host activity or an SLA.

cases: uses real authorization-code/PKCE login and keeps Secure cookies, purpose and replay boundaries
rejects issuer/audience/client/nonce/signature/expiry mismatches and unregistered/inactive/cross-tenant subjects
enforces CSRF, tenant assignment, strict schemas, durable idempotency and pending delegation status over HTTP
issues and consumes real signed authorizations once across concurrent HTTP requests, rejecting tampering and unavailable authority
requires real recent auth_time and revokes active sessions through the account-management API
blocks new work after trust publication or recovery mismatch without creating partial state
reads institution recall snapshots through actual sessions and rejects customer access
boundary: rejects replayed joint signatures and forged event/state/witness evidence without prematurely activating a directory-only change
boundary: separates first-connect expiry from lease expiry and never reactivates terminal attempts
boundary: preserves a live synthetic lease for display changes but revokes it on confirmed policy generation changes
recall HTTP/SQL: keeps DELETE success, missing resources and unavailable observation distinct through real runtime writes
boundary: stops analysis transport and late model results after consent withdrawal, then isolates new revisions and provider failure
boundary: stops a pending model after lease-policy changes without publishing the late result
boundary: stops a pending model after connection-generation changes without publishing the late result
analysis HTTP/WS: preserves rule warnings alongside purpose results and retracts corrected, duplicate and reversed evidence
analysis HTTP/WS: rejects invented-evidence while retaining supported rules and product-controlled actions
analysis HTTP/WS: rejects external-command while retaining supported rules and product-controlled actions
analysis HTTP/WS: rejects epoch mismatch before forwarding a new frame
analysis HTTP/WS: rejects key-generation mismatch before forwarding a new frame
analysis HTTP/WS: rejects binding mismatch before forwarding a new frame
analysis HTTP/WS: account disable invalidates real authenticated sockets and pending provider work
analysis HTTP/WS: enforces the remote context identity cap and releases the stream
analysis HTTP/WS: rejects an expired session row and cancels its pending provider result
analysis HTTP/WS: SQL quota denial keeps rule evidence and never invokes the model adapter
analysis HTTP/WS: drains real quota before issuer shutdown even when a provider ignores abort
boundary: reviews and exports a real proposal, imports independent signatures, then distinguishes submission, confirmation and activation
boundary: shows durable worker failure instead of active configuration
boundary: synchronizes work logout across tabs while keeping official session separate, and clears expired official tasks
boundary: drops a held old-account response, clears management drafts on account switch and refuses revoked buttons
boundary: disables ungranted manager actions, rejects their HTTP bypass and clears work expiry on reload
boundary: recovers a committed creation after a lost response without duplicating the intent and cancels it safely
recall Chromium: renders real cancellation observations and clears a held response on visibility events and account switch
analysis Chromium: renders authenticated WebSocket results in the shipped panel with synthetic binding and no media device
renders the actual service in Chromium, completes OIDC login, creates/cancels work and isolates recipient menus

databaseCountInterpretation: The used=176 sum is across overlapping quota scopes; it is not176 provider calls or a billing total. Reservations/outbox/sessions are zero only in the corrected clean regression DB. Original17 orphans were not repaired or reset.

originalFailures.label: analysis-ws
originalFailures.cause: Two timing failures: synchronous abort expectation despite async authority check; per-message polling consumed authority freshness before identity-cap boundary.

originalFailures.label: chromium
originalFailures.cause: Recall filter accessible name did not match its visible label.

originalFailures.label: recall-browser-regression
originalFailures.cause: 390px horizontal overflow from a long native select option.

originalFailures.label: analysis-browser
originalFailures.cause: Vitest rewrote dynamic import inside serialized page.evaluate; browser module loader corrected without changing product API.

originalFailures.label: audit-before-rerun
originalFailures.cause: Audio shutdown could close quota pool before socket settlement; abort-ignoring provider retained reservations. Fixture deleted reserved rows without checking balances. Audit found seventeen nonzero balance rows.

commands.http-auth-final: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.http.config.ts tests/integration/service-http.test.ts --testNamePattern '^(?!renders the actual service)'
commands.http-recall-final: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.http.config.ts tests/integration/service-boundaries.test.ts --testNamePattern '^(recall HTTP/SQL:|boundary: rejects replayed joint|boundary: separates first-connect|boundary: preserves a live synthetic)'
commands.ws-final: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.http.config.ts tests/integration/service-boundaries.test.ts --testNamePattern '^(analysis HTTP/WS:|boundary: stops analysis transport|boundary: stops a pending model)'
commands.chromium-final: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.http.config.ts --testNamePattern '^(renders the actual service|recall Chromium:|analysis Chromium:|boundary: (reviews and exports|shows durable|synchronizes work logout|drops a held|disables ungranted|recovers a committed))'
